title: backend_validate() promised but unimplemented
description: wp11_backend.h lines 105-127 document sign/verify/decrypt as 'MUST NOT be NULL' and state 'wp11_backend_validate() checks it at registration time'. That function does not exist anywhere in the codebase. A backend registered with NULL sign/verify/decrypt will silently succeed registration and then NULL-dereference at first C_Sign/C_Verify/C_Decrypt call. Fix: either implement wp11_backend_validate() to assert these pointers at registration time, or remove the false promise from the documentation and replace with a note that NULL dereferences are caught at call time only.
